mcpTasks.body: Observe remote work, recover results and request cancellation for this session.

composer.placeholderRunning: Add a note, queue the next task, or steer…
composer.placeholderIdle: Describe what you want to build…
composer.keys: Enter sends · Shift Enter adds a line · ↑ recalls input · @ files · $ skills · / commands.

modeTitle.btw: Idle: start a turn. Running: send a BTW note to this session’s leader.
modeTitle.queue: Add a persistent prompt. If idle it starts immediately.
modeTitle.steer: Interrupt the current turn, then start your instruction. Clear pending queue first.

composer.attachmentsQueued: Attachments start a queued turn after the current run. Choose Stop & steer to interrupt.
composer.topicChecking: Checking whether this request starts a different topic… Your draft is kept.

topic.title: Start a new topic context?
topic.body: A fresh context keeps earlier conversation details out of the next request. Project files and the recorded session stay available. This choice applies only when you approve sending.

restore.text: Your composer already contains a draft.

execution.title: Execution & permissions
execution.description: Defaults for new conversations and agent runs.

context.title: Context & reasoning
context.description: Control how new conversations use context and model reasoning.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Choose which WrongStack systems are available in new runs.

routing.title: Agents & fallbacks
routing.description: Shared concurrency and fallback defaults for new work.

notifications.title: HQ, proxy & Telegram
notifications.description: Publishing to WrongStack HQ, the local WrongProxy route for provider requests, and Telegram notifications. Telegram settings appear once a bot token is configured.

terminal-display.title: Terminal display
terminal-display.description: How the WrongStack terminal UI shows work in progress. These profile settings do not change the desktop app’s own view.

logging.title: Logs & diagnostics
logging.description: Control the detail recorded by WrongStack.

autonomy.label: Continuation mode
autonomy.description: Choose how WrongStack continues after completing a step.

maxIterations.label: Iteration budget
maxIterations.description: Maximum iterations for a new agent run. Zero means unlimited. Running conversations keep their current budget.

autoProceedMaxIterations.label: Automatic continuation budget
autoProceedMaxIterations.description: Maximum continuation steps before another user decision is needed. Zero uses the engine’s unlimited setting.

breakerEnabled.label: Circuit breaker
breakerEnabled.description: Stop repeated failures and runaway tool loops.

breakerAutoKillResetMs.label: Breaker reset delay
breakerAutoKillResetMs.description: How long the circuit breaker waits before resetting.

nextStepsMode.label: Require next steps
nextStepsMode.description: Every finished turn ends with next steps or a completion marker, so automatic continuation keeps going until the agent declares the work complete. The continuation budget still pauses it.

fsAccess.label: Filesystem access
fsAccess.description: Scope of the file tools. Applies on the next session.

options.project: Project — confined to the project root

contextMode.label: Context profile
contextMode.description: Balanced for everyday work, frugal for smaller context, or deep for detailed analysis.

contextStrategy.label: Context strategy
contextStrategy.description: How the engine selects and compresses conversation context.

contextAutoCompact.label: Automatic compaction
contextAutoCompact.description: Compact older context when the conversation approaches its window limit.

tokenSavingTier.label: Token saving
tokenSavingTier.description: Balance prompt detail against token usage.

reasoningMode.label: Model reasoning
reasoningMode.description: Follow provider defaults, request reasoning, or disable it when supported.

reasoningEffort.label: Reasoning effort
reasoningEffort.description: Requested effort for providers that support this control.

reasoningPreserve.label: Preserve reasoning
reasoningPreserve.description: Retain provider reasoning context when the model supports it.

systemPromptVariant.label: Agent identity
systemPromptVariant.description: Choose the identity for new runs: Lite, Standard or Pro coding guidance, general-purpose Scout, or minimal Quick.

includeGlobalAgents.label: Global AGENTS.md
includeGlobalAgents.description: Load ~/.wrongstack/AGENTS.md into the system prompt of new runs.

includeProjectAgents.label: Project AGENTS.md
includeProjectAgents.description: Load the project's root AGENTS.md into the system prompt of new runs.

featureMemory.label: Project memory
featureMemory.description: Use SAGE to preserve and retrieve durable project knowledge.

featureSkills.label: Skills
featureSkills.description: Discover and use installed workflow instructions.

featureMcp.label: MCP connections
featureMcp.description: Expose enabled external tool servers to the engine.

featureToolCoach.label: Tool coach
featureToolCoach.description: Help the agent choose and use available tools effectively.

featureModelsRegistry.label: Model registry
featureModelsRegistry.description: Use model capability and availability catalogs.

indexOnStart.label: Index code at startup
indexOnStart.description: Prepare the codebase index when a project runtime starts.

readSymbols.label: Read symbols
readSymbols.description: The read tool includes codebase-index symbols alongside file content.

showSageMemoryInject.label: Show SAGE memory injection
showSageMemoryInject.description: Show the SAGE memory-injection blocks added to tool results.

sageMemoryInjectThreshold.label: SAGE memory injection threshold
sageMemoryInjectThreshold.description: Minimum relation strength required for an injected SAGE memory.

maxConcurrent.label: Concurrent agents
maxConcurrent.description: Maximum simultaneous agents allowed by the engine.

fallbackAuto.label: Automatic model fallback
fallbackAuto.description: Try the configured fallback chain when a provider or model is unavailable.

favoriteModelsOnly.label: Favorites only
favoriteModelsOnly.description: When automatic fallback derives a chain, restrict it to your favorite models.

hangTimeoutMs.label: Silence between chunks
hangTimeoutMs.description: Longest pause allowed once a reply is streaming before the attempt is failed and retried. Raise it for models with long silent thinking phases. 0 turns it off.
hangTimeoutMs.unset: Default: 60 s (240 s for MiniMax and Z.AI)

headersTimeoutMs.label: Wait for response headers
headersTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the provider to start answering at all. 0 turns it off.
headersTimeoutMs.unset: Default: 60 s (180 s for MiniMax and Z.AI)

cacheTtl.label: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: Requested cache lifetime for providers that support prompt caching.

wrongProxyEnabled.label: Route provider requests through WrongProxy
wrongProxyEnabled.description: Rewrites every provider’s base URL through the local proxy (default http://localhost:3444/proxy/<host><path>). openai-codex is excluded; it talks to the ChatGPT backend directly. Applies to the next request.

wrongProxyUrl.label: Proxy URL
wrongProxyUrl.description: Where the proxy daemon listens. Its /api/health is probed; an unreachable daemon turns rewriting off until it answers again.

hqEnabled.label: HQ publishing
hqEnabled.description: Publish this client’s sessions to WrongStack HQ.

hqToken.label: HQ client token
hqToken.description: The client token issued by WrongStack HQ.
hqToken.unset: A saved token is never shown here.
hqToken.placeholder: Type a new token to replace the saved one

hqRawContent.label: Raw HQ content
hqRawContent.description: Send raw content previews to HQ instead of redacted previews.

tgSessionEnd.label: Telegram: session end
tgSessionEnd.description: Send a summary when a session ends.

tgDelegate.label: Telegram: delegate finished
tgDelegate.description: Send a note when a subagent completes.

tgLongToolMs.label: Telegram: long-running tools
tgLongToolMs.description: Notify when a tool runs longer than this. 0 turns it off.

tgPollIntervalSec.label: Telegram polling interval
tgPollIntervalSec.description: Seconds between Telegram polls. Lower is more responsive but makes more API calls.

tgChatId.label: Telegram notification chat
tgChatId.description: Default chat ID for notifications. A positive ID pairs your private chat with the bot; group IDs (negative) are refused unless allowGroupChats is enabled in the config. Leave empty to clear.

statuslineMode.label: Statusline mode
statuslineMode.description: Density of the terminal statusline rail.

thinkingWord.label: Thinking word
thinkingWord.description: One short word shown in the terminal status chip while the agent works: up to 16 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.

animationStyle.label: Animation style
animationStyle.description: Animation of the terminal’s working-state chip.

showModelReasoning.label: Show model reasoning
showModelReasoning.description: Show the model’s reasoning blocks in the terminal and WebUI chat history.

preRefineSeconds.label: Pre-refine countdown
preRefineSeconds.description: Grace period before the prompt refiner starts. 0 skips the countdown and refines at once.

multiDiffSummaryThreshold.label: Multi-diff summary
multiDiffSummaryThreshold.description: Minimum number of changed files before the aggregate “N files · +X −Y” line is shown above the per-file diffs. 0 turns it off.

logLevel.label: Log detail
logLevel.description: Choose the minimum severity recorded in engine logs.

auditLevel.label: Audit detail
auditLevel.description: How much evidence is retained for tool execution and decisions.

debugStream.label: Stream diagnostics
debugStream.description: Record additional provider streaming diagnostics while investigating a problem.

advanced.refinement: Refiner provider/model, named profile, language, review on submit and a saved-route sample preview.
advanced.execution: Standard approvals, YOLO, YOLO+, destructive operation confirmations, disk wipe, publish, trusted state and credential binding.
advanced.brain: Risk ceiling, escalation, decision cache, heuristics, model quality, monitor, stall, error storm, file churn, cooldown, council, ledger and replay trace path/capacity.
advanced.fleet: Concurrent agents, Memory Companion, Explore Companion, Skill Companion and next-step guidance.
advanced.model-visibility: Enabled models, favorites and reviewed cleanup of fallback references.
advanced.reviews: Chimera and continuous review models, batches, follow-up and cascade policy.
advanced.model-routing: Model and reasoning overrides for each role or phase.
advanced.cost-tiers: Worker models, explicit budgets and tier switching rules.
advanced.resource-limits: Optional context, output and worker budget overrides.
advanced.availability: Provider and model time windows, weekdays, overnight schedules and timezones.
advanced.instructions: User rules and AGENTS.md across projects and profiles.
advanced.tool-access: Registered tool catalog, permission metadata, enable and disable tools.
